web.title_en: InjectEave: Recovering Headphone Audio from 30 Meters Away via Active Electromagnetic Injection
web.description_en: This article unveils InjectEave, a breakthrough attack technique that leverages hardware nonlinearity to modulate low-frequency audio onto high frequencies via active RF signal injection. This extends electromagnetic eavesdropping range from under 1.5 meters to 30 meters with wall-penetration capabilities, fundamentally breaking the physical limits of traditional passive side-channel attacks. The research not only demonstrates the feasibility of remotely recovering audio from various headphones and IoT devices using commercial equipment, but also shockingly showcases a real-time "eavesdrop-synthesize-inject" closed-loop attack combined with AI voice cloning, sounding the alarm for hardware security design.

web.title: Adobe Patches Magento Zero-Day Exploited to Deploy Rust Backdoor and PHP Web Shell
web.description: Adobe on Monday released security patches to address a maximum-severity flaw impacting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that has come under active exploitation in the wild.   The vulnerability, now tracked as CVE-2026-75650  (CVSS score: 10.0), has been codenamed StyleSmuggler  by Sansec, which discovered zero-day exploitation starting September 4, 2026.   "This update resolves a critical vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution," Adobe said , adding it's "aware that CVE-2026-75650 has been exploited in the wild targeting Adobe Commerce merchants."   At its core, the flaw abuses Magento's template system through PHP code injection to generate a "Payment Transaction Failed Reminder" email, triggering code execution in the process.
